name: IT combo-pipeline child
description: The child of IT combo-pipeline: a while that counts twice and a retry that passes at its second attempt, both into the file its parent began in the scratch directory, and a step that prints the file.

config.command: n=$(( $(grep -c '^pass ' "{{ scratch_dir }}/trail.txt") + 1 )); echo pass $n >> "{{ scratch_dir }}/trail.txt"; echo pass $n
n=$(( $(grep -c '^attempt ' "{{ scratch_dir }}/trail.txt") + 1 )); echo attempt $n >> "{{ scratch_dir }}/trail.txt"; if [ $n -lt 2 ]; then echo attempt $n fails; exit 1; fi; echo attempt $n passes
